name: ClinicalProtocolDeviationLog
tagline: Log, classify, report and close protocol deviations – ICH E3 classification, IRB/EC and serious-breach clocks, recurrence and CAPA in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete plug-and-play protocol deviation app for sponsors, CROs and investigator sites. Log deviations by site and subject, classify them as important or non-important with the deviation plan's category list, assess impact, decide IRB/EC reportability and serious-breach status, track the IRB/EC and 7-day breach deadlines, detect recurring deviations per site and category, record root cause and corrective / preventive actions, and close only after an independent effectiveness check. Works immediately in demo mode; connect a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or Power Pages Web API in a few clicks. Not a medical device.
features: ICH E3 important / non-important classification with rationale for down-classification
Four-eyes assessment and independent CAPA effectiveness check
Recurrence detection by site and category (90 days)
Root cause and CA/PA actions with owners, due dates, extensions and cancellations
14 quick filters, grouping by subject, bulk actions, CSV export
Undo, audit history, read-only mode for auditors
controlType: standard (2 controls: ClinicalProtocolDeviationLog dataset + ClinicalProtocolDeviationLogPortal field control)
